results.title: Dongwon Autopart Technology Plans Emanuel County, Georgia, Production Operations - Area Development
results.content:
Dongwon Autopart Technology supplies components such as doorframes, seat frames, and battery frames to automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). [...] Dongwon Autopart Technology, an automotive supplier that manufactures precision metal components and assemblies, plans to establish operations in Swainsboro, Georgia. The $30 million project is expected to create 200 jobs in Emanuel County.  
  
 The investment will include the conduction of a new manufacturing facility that will be located at the Hwy 297 Industrial Park. [...] “The automotive industry is expanding outward along the I-16 corridor as suppliers choose strategic locations with access to OEMs and Georgia’s ports,” noted GDEcD Commissioner Pat Wilson. “Dongwon Autopart Technology’s second location in Georgia is a testament to the robust growth of Georgia’s automotive industry, which has been creating jobs across the state for more than 100 years. Congratulations to Emanuel County for the new opportunities this investment will create across the community.”

results.content:
“Dongwon Autopart Technology has been in the United States since 2003, and we are proud to be part of growing the state’s automotive industry,” Heather Hollstein, Human Resources Manager at Dongwon Autopart Technology, said. [...] , will construct the facility at the Hwy 297 Industrial Park near Swainsboro, with construction set to begin this year.

The company, established in 1971, already operates a facility in Hogansville, Georgia, which will remain operational. The new site represents Dongwon’s second Georgia location and is part of the supplier’s expansion across the Southeast, where it currently supports more than 500 direct jobs. [...] Skip to content
